recommendations.title: Refresh: Fox ESS CQ7 — homeowner-friendly review
recommendations.details: Add a dedicated review section on the existing battery comparison page that translates datasheet specs into a concise homeowner-facing review: summary (what the CQ7 is best for), key specifications (capacity, voltage range, efficiency, warranty, IP rating), clear pros and cons, typical module counts and expected usable capacity examples, and recommended use-cases (e.g., large outdoor systems). Include a short paragraph on fire suppression (aerosol) and what IP65 means for rooftop/ground installations.

recommendations.title: Create: Pricing & payback guidance for battery models
recommendations.details: Produce a short section or standalone how-to that shows how to estimate cost, cost-per-kWh and simple payback for home battery systems, using example calculations that could be filled in with vendor prices (include an example row for Fox ESS CQ7 showing usable capacity per module and sample module counts). Explain which factors change payback (electricity price, export rules, self-consumption, green rebate) and what pricing questions customers should ask installers.
suggestedSections: Hur man räknar på payback (formel och exempel)

recommendations.title: Refresh: Add field experience and datasheet links
recommendations.details: On the battery comparison page, add verifiable references: direct links to the Fox ESS CQ7 datasheet and warranty PDF, and a short installer or customer testimonial about CQ7 installations (performance, reliability, any service issues). If internal field data exists, summarise uptime/performance observations versus datasheet claims.
